channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Two men killed in early morning shooting on Southeast Rivergreen Circle in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Port St. Lucie Police Department is investigating a double fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning in a residential neighborhood. item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offering free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents with residential pools.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters following hazing investigation
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District released investigative reports detailing allegations of hazing that led to the termination of 3 firefighters and the suspension of 2 others.

item.title: Lightning strikes cause brush fire and house fire in Port St. Lucie during severe weather
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District crews responded to a brush fire and house fire in Port St. Lucie as severe weather brought heavy lightning activity to the area Friday.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Five cyclospora cases confirmed on Treasure Coast since May as residents avoid lettuce
item.description: Two confirmed cases in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County are among five local cyclospora infections reported since May, according to the Florida Department of Health.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 on Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's previous mark of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday with President Trump attending
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement and private companies have prepared for two years to secure Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey, where President Trump will attend the trophy presentation.

item.title: Lionel Messi bathed Lamine Yamal as baby, now face off in World Cup final
item.description: Photos from 2007 show a teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in a charity calendar shoot. The two soccer stars will face each other Sunday when Argentina plays Spain in the World Cup final.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Halloween flight from Stuart airport to Georgia documented
item.description: A family flight in a Piper Aztec departed Stuart airport bound for Baxley, Georgia on a Halloween trip.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters after hazing investigation
item.description: Three firefighters were fired and two suspended after an investigation found senior firefighters used a modified bug zapper to shock probationary employees during shifts in 2024.

item.title: Unity in the Community event brings together Fort Pierce families and public safety
item.description: The annual Fort Pierce event connects families with services and public safety demonstrations.
